transcript: Speaker A: उसने 7 जनम रहने का वादा किया था पर 6 साल में ही छोड़ दिया। मेरा नाम रितु है। [He promised to stay for 7 lifetimes but left in 6 years. My name is Ritu.] ... हर जगह एक ही सवाल—'English communication कैसी है आपकी?' मैं चुप हो जाती थी। [Everywhere the same question—'How is your English communication?' I used to keep quiet.] ... English Seekho app का ad आया। 1 रुपये में तीन दिन का trial. [I saw an ad for the English Seekho app. A 3-day trial for 1 rupee.] ... 15 minute AI coach से practice. [15 minutes of practice with the AI coach.] ... नौकरी मिली, 24,000 रुपये महीना। [I got a job, 24,000 rupees a month.] ... Speaker B: Install Now पर क्लिक करो और अभी English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click Install Now and download the English Seekho app now.]
on_screen_text: 7 janam rahne ka wada kiya tha [Promised to stay for 7 lifetimes] ... English Seekho ... Install Now
summary: A woman shares her story of being abandoned by her husband and facing job rejection due to poor English. She gains confidence and secures a job after practicing with the English Seekho app's AI coach. The ad invites viewers to start a 3-day trial for 1 rupee.
